geometryMethod: Manual visual selection of imaging regions on the committed 989x989 basemap. Pixel coordinates reference image edges; transform with the basemap geotransform. These are candidate imaging ROIs, not mapped geological units, mineral boundaries or documented unvisited areas.
sourceAccessNotes: NASA/JPL, NTRS and HiRISE pages reviewed. Publisher DOI endpoint returned 403; named Garden City associations were reviewed in Table 1 text of the LANL accepted manuscript exposed by web search. Stable DOI is retained; no expiring signed download URL is used.
limits: No new chemical values or quantitative mineral abundances exported.
Orbital polygons are reviewed imaging regions, not mineral/unit boundaries or evidence of unvisited terrain.
